psychological_meaning: Heather is a muted, cool-toned color that evokes feelings of serenity and tranquility. It is often associated with nature, particularly the heather plant and its calming presence in landscapes. The color promotes relaxation and can create a sense of peace and contemplation. Heather can also represent sophistication and understated elegance.
